title: Weakly Ding injective complexes
summary: Working over a (left) coherent ring, we consider the class of weakly Ding injective complexes. These are the cycles of the exact complexes of FP-injective complexes that stay exact when applying $\Hom(A,-)$ for any FP-injective complex $A$. We study the cotorsion pair generated by the class of all such complexes, and exhibit it as part of an abelian model structure. As an application we show that when $R$ is a Ding-Chen ring, its stable chain complex category is compactly generated and triangle equivalent to the stable category of four Frobenius categories.
